Fam! Living in a digital world is great, but we should also realize the value of hard copies. These companies can disappear your favorite movie at anytime. I hate that a lot of these Black documentaries or movies from streaming services don’t allow us to buy our own copy.

Video
Damn. Boston 13-47 from 3-point line. They are about to lose Game 7. The 76’ers are up 6 with 20 seconds left.

It’s crazy how we have been breaking down the impact of the GOP’s attacks on Black political power on #RolandMartinUnfiltered, and all I see are clips on @Mediaite of the same lame mainstream media discussions. It’s as if Black-owned media doesn’t exist.

Happy Birthday to my man Roame, an original member (Percussions/Vocals) of the iconic band, Maze featuring Frankie Beverly. Roame is the only remaining original member who recorded on every song in the Maze catalog.  Roame is still sharing “Happy Feelings” as Maze continues the legacy.  #TheButlers #RawSoul #Maze
